title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Approval of the Award
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a complete Medical Hardship application is approved with its award dates and its hardship liability cap.

**Completeness for approval.** For a Medical Hardship application on which the patient responsibility posted to the patient's Riverbend accounts in the twelve whole months before the application date (a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it), less the adjustments posted to them in those months, exceeds the tier's hardship medical debt percent of the annual household income recorded on the case, and only for such an application (any other application, and every renewal application whatever its debt, is complete only as the last clause of this sentence states), the application is complete for approval once every document type in the tier's required document list other than outside medical bills has been accepted; every other application is complete only when every document type in the tier's required document list has been accepted.

**The determination.** For a Medical Hardship award determined under this schedule the approval is the determination made on the call: the charity adjustments that apply the award to each covered encounter are booked afterwards in Riverbend's posting cycle, not as part of the determination.

**The hardship liability cap is fixed only after Riverbend has completed the documentation of the qualifying medical debt with the other medical costs of the window.** Equivalently: until that documentation is complete on the case, no hardship liability cap is fixed.

## Invocation — `approve_hardship_award_afb08b0b`

The agent unlocks `approve_hardship_award_afb08b0b` and calls it as a financial counselor's approval of a Medical Hardship financial assistance case. The case moves to approved status with today's date as its determination date, the given earliest and last covered dates of service, and the given hardship liability cap; an approval letter is logged on the case, dated today and written in the given language. The patient can see the approved award, its covered dates and its liability cap, and the approval letter on the case.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format / values |
|---|---|---|
| `fap_case_id` | the reference number of the financial assistance case being approved, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for the patient | case id |
| `hardship_liability_cap_usd` | the hardship liability cap of the award, in USD | non-negative, 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places |
| `award_start_date` | the earliest date of service the award covers | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `award_end_date` | the last date of service the award covers | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `notice_language` | the language of the approval letter | English (preferred language English or not one of the letter languages); Spanish (preferred language Spanish); Hmong (preferred language Hmong) |

Return: "Case <case> approved on <determination date>: covers services <start> to <end>, hardship liability cap <amount> USD; approval letter <letter reference> logged in <language>." The receipt appearing means the award is approved and the letter is on the case.
